card.name: Opening parenthesis of next list item
card.fires_on: An opening parenthesis that begins the next numbered or lettered item, such as (2) or (B), in a list or step sequence inside label text.

modes.label: Next numbered step
modes.description: Parenthesis opening the number of the following step or item after a previous (1) item.
modes.example: Move the safety sheath away from the needle and towards the syringe and<< (>>2) remove the clear needle cover immediately

modes.label: Lettered section marker
modes.description: Parenthesis opening a letter such as (B) after a sentence ending, starting a new warning section.
modes.example: pathological bleeding or completion of a course of therapy ( 2.6 , 2.7 , 2.8 , 5.1 ).<< (>>B) SPINAL/EPIDURAL

card.writes: It suppresses other parenthesis tokens, so the model does not predict another opening bracket form and expects the list label to be completed.
card.plain: It fires on the opening bracket of the next list marker, like the start of (2) or (B).
